items.Sentence: The Facility consists of three raw water lift stations, a headworks facility, three wave oxidation Biolac® activated sludge treatment units equipped with diffusers that provide extended aeration, three secondary clarifiers, an activated sludge pumping station, an ultraviolet disinfection system, and solar greenhouse sludge drying structures.
Raw wastewater is directed through the plant headworks, which consists of a step screen, compactor, vortex grit pump, and a grit separator.
